mapper.sql: SELECT c.*, g.name AS goods_name, g.main_image, g.status AS goods_status, g.shop_id, sk.spec AS sku_spec, sk.price, sk.stock FROM cart c JOIN goods g ON c.goods_id = g.id JOIN sku sk ON c.sku_id = sk.id
mapper.select: WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.id DESC
SELECT * FROM cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND sku_id = #{skuId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart (user_id, goods_id, sku_id, quantity, checked) VALUES (#{userId}, #{goodsId}, #{skuId}, #{quantity}, #{checked})
mapper.update: UPDATE cart SET quantity = #{quantity} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id}
